people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
translations.bsb: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.
translations.kjv: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
translations.asv: And Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way; and his disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
